column1: # IPO watch: the big upcoming US listings PreBell tracks (docs/runbook.md, "IPO watch").
# One line per company, tab-separated. Everything else (forms, cover facts, dates, news)
# comes from EDGAR and the news sweep, never from this file. At most 10 rows.
# slug: the page URL (/en/ipo/<slug>), lowercase a-z, 0-9 and "-".
# cik: the SEC CIK (EDGAR company search). name: the display name. name_zh: "-" for none.
# aliases: other names news quotes use for the company, comma-separated, "-" for none. A news
# item is kept only when its quote names the company by `name` or an alias (docs/decisions.md).

column6: S-1 filed 2026-10-26; S-1/A with a price range 2026-11-10
